direction: Match Tavvik's short steel-grey anvil body, horn pointing left, narrow waist, broad pedestal and little boots. Keep the inset dark eyes, soot-smudged brass and teal goggles, graphite keyline, and outlined grey mittens. Work at fixed camera, height, anchor and baseline. Keep the prop sizes, finish and grips from the approved sheets. Flat shaded transparent 2D sticker cels without text. Leave effects to separate GPU layers. Keep the same wrist grip and a rigid perpendicular head as the shaft follows the swing. At contact the shaft is horizontal and the striking end rests flat on the coin.

panels.action: The small square steel hammer rests above the workstand, coin on it. Tavvik looks down at the coin.
The mitten lifts the same hammer high with a slight lean back, feet on the baseline.
Swing the closed right fist down toward the coin. The horizontal shaft points into the vertical head. The lower end makes flat contact.
The hammer bounces back slightly, then settles into the waiting pose.

use: Working on something or celebrating a build.
